title: Unit 5 第一课时 基础达标与综合拓展

sections.title: I. 语音练习
sections.instruction: 语音练习，写出下列单词画线部分的音标

questions.prompt: pl<u>ay</u>
questions.translation: play 单词画线部分 ay 的发音

questions.prompt: cl<u>u</u>b
questions.translation: club 单词画线部分 u 的发音

questions.prompt: m<u>u</u>sic
questions.translation: music 单词画线部分 u 的发音

questions.prompt: w<u>a</u>nt
questions.translation: want 单词画线部分 a 的发音

questions.prompt: music(形容词)
questions.translation: music 的形容词形式

questions.prompt: good(副词)
questions.translation: good 的副词形式

questions.prompt: can(否定形式)
questions.translation: can 的否定形式

questions.prompt: too(同义词)
options: also 和 as well 都是
questions.translation: too 的同义词
questions.explanation: too 意为“也”，用于肯定句句末；also 常用在句中（be动词后，行为动词前）；as well 常用在肯定句句末，两者都是 too 的同义词，故选 also 和 as well 都是。

sections.title: III. 根据句意和汉语提示写出所缺的单词
sections.instruction: 根据句意和汉语提示写出所缺的单词

questions.prompt: My music teacher can play the ______ (鼓). We all like her.
questions.translation: 我的音乐老师会打鼓。我们都很喜欢她。

questions.prompt: Lisa wants to learn to ______ (唱) an English song.
questions.translation: 丽莎想学唱一首英文歌。

questions.prompt: Sam likes summer very much because he can ______ (游泳) in the pool.
questions.translation: 萨姆非常喜欢夏天，因为他可以在游泳池里游泳。

questions.prompt: She likes to ______ (跳舞). She wants to be a dancer.
questions.translation: 她喜欢跳舞。她想成为一名舞蹈演员。

questions.prompt:
—What club do you want to join? 
—The sports club. I can run ______ (快地).
questions.translation: —你想加入什么俱乐部？—运动俱乐部。我能跑得快。

sections.title: IV. 用合适的冠词填空
sections.instruction: 用合适的冠词 (a, an, the) 填空或不填 (/)

questions.prompt: Can your brother play ______ guitar?
questions.translation: 你弟弟会弹吉他吗？

questions.prompt: Today is sunny. I want to play ______ basketball.
questions.translation: 今天天气晴朗。我想打篮球。

questions.prompt: My grandfather plays ______ Chinese chess in the park every day.
questions.translation: 我爷爷每天都在公园下中国象棋。

questions.prompt: Is there ______ drama club in your school?
questions.translation: 你们学校有戏剧俱乐部吗？

questions.prompt: Mary is in China now but she can't speak ______ Chinese.
questions.translation: 玛丽现在在中国，但她不会说中文。

sections.title: V. 按要求完成句子
sections.instruction: 按要求完成句子，选择最佳选项。

questions.prompt:
1. I want to join <u>the ping-pong club</u>. (对画线部分提问)
______ ______ ______ you want to join?
questions.translation: 我想加入乒乓球俱乐部。—— 你想加入什么俱乐部？
questions.explanation: 对俱乐部提问用 What club，一般现在时主语为 you，助动词用 do，故选 What club do。

questions.prompt:
2. Can you play Chinese chess? (作肯定回答和否定回答)
______, I ______. / ______, I ______.
options: Yes, I can; No, I can’t
Yes, I do; No, I don’t
Yes, can do; No, can’t do
questions.translation: 你会下中国象棋吗？—— 是的，我会。/ 不，我不会。
questions.explanation: Can 引导的一般疑问句，肯定回答为 Yes, I can. 否定回答为 No, I can’t. 故选 Yes, I can; No, I can’t。

questions.prompt:
3. Bob can draw pictures. (改为一般疑问句)
______ Bob ______ ______?
questions.translation: 鲍勃会画画。—— 鲍勃会画画吗？
questions.explanation: 含情态动词 can 的陈述句变一般疑问句，将 Can 提到句首，动词保持原形 draw pictures，故选 Can; draw pictures。

questions.prompt:
4. I can play <u>the piano</u>. (对画线部分提问)
______ ______ you play?
questions.translation: 我会弹钢琴。—— 你会弹/演奏什么？
questions.explanation: 对事物 the piano 提问用疑问词 What，后面接情态动词 can + 主语 you + 动词原形 play，故选 What can。

sections.title: VI. 语篇填空
sections.instruction: 阅读短文, 在空白处填入一个适当的单词或用括号内所给单词的正确形式填空, 使短文通顺、连贯。
sections.passage:
Hello, everyone! Welcome to our Sunshine Club. I'm Mary. Let [1] (I) show you around now.
First, let's go to the music room. There [2] (be) 20 students in it. Miss Black is an [3] (America) teacher. She is kind and she makes friends [4] students.
Next we are going to another room—the art room. You can draw [5] (picture) in this room. That is [6] (they) teacher, Mr. Green. He is very [7] (friend).
Finally, it's time to visit [8] chess room. Here all the students are very quiet—no one [9] (talk). The tall man with short hair is Mr. White. Kids like his classes.
In the end, I hope all of you have fun here [10] you are welcome to join us.

questions.prompt: Let [1] (I) show you around now.
questions.translation: 让我现在带你们参观一下。

questions.prompt: There [2] (be) 20 students in it.
questions.translation: 里面有20名学生。

questions.prompt: Miss Black is an [3] (America) teacher.
questions.translation: 布莱克小姐是一位美国老师。

questions.prompt: She is kind and she makes friends [4] students.
questions.translation: 她很和蔼，和学生们交朋友。

questions.prompt: You can draw [5] (picture) in this room.
questions.translation: 你可以在这个房间里画画。

questions.prompt: That is [6] (they) teacher, Mr. Green.
questions.translation: 那是他们的老师，格林先生。

questions.prompt: He is very [7] (friend).
questions.translation: 他非常友好。

questions.prompt: Finally, it's time to visit [8] chess room.
questions.translation: 最后，是时候参观棋室了。

questions.prompt: Here all the students are very quiet—no one [9] (talk).
questions.translation: 这里所有的学生都很安静——没有人说话。

questions.prompt: In the end, I hope all of you have fun here [10] you are welcome to join us.
questions.translation: 最后，我希望你们所有人在这里玩得开心，欢迎加入我们。

sections.title: VII. 阅读表达
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，根据短文内容回答问题
sections.passage:
We have lots of clubs in our school. You can choose and join a club according to (根据) what you can do.

# Table Tennis Club
Can you play table tennis? Or are you interested in playing table tennis? Then you can join our club. We'll practice (练习) it at 4:00 p.m. on the school playground every Tuesday. Please call us at 2851-3654. We are waiting for you.

# Drama Club
Are you good at reading? Can you read words with feeling? Do you want to act with us? Join the drama club now! Your dream of being an actor (演员) can come true here. You can call Ms. White at 5983-5489 or visit www.dramaclub.com.

questions.prompt: Henry likes playing table tennis. How can he contact the table tennis club?
options: He can talk to Ms. White.
questions.translation: 亨利喜欢打乒乓球。他如何联系乒乓球俱乐部？

questions.prompt: John is in the table tennis club. When should he practice table tennis?
questions.translation: 约翰在乒乓球俱乐部。他什么时候应该练习乒乓球？
questions.explanation: 故选 Every Tuesday at 4:00 p.m.。

questions.prompt: If you want to join the drama club, what can you do?
options: Be good at reading and acting.
questions.translation: 如果你想加入戏剧俱乐部，你能做什么？
questions.explanation: 故选 Be good at reading and acting.。

questions.prompt: How many ways are mentioned to get more information about the drama club?
questions.translation: 提到了几种获取关于戏剧俱乐部更多信息的方法？
questions.explanation: 故选 Two ways.（打电话或访问网址）

questions.prompt: Which club do you want to join, the table tennis club or the drama club? Why?
options: The table tennis club, because I like sports.
The drama club, because I don't like reading.
questions.translation: 你想加入哪个俱乐部，乒乓球俱乐部还是戏剧俱乐部？为什么？
questions.explanation: 故选 The table tennis club, because I like sports.（合理即可）

sections.title: VIII. 阅读还原
sections.instruction: 请认真阅读下面短文，从短文后的选项中选出能填入空白处的最佳选项。选项中有两项为多余选项。
sections.passage:
Have you ever looked closely at the paper money from different countries? You will see more than numbers and colours. You will discover pictures of rivers, mountains, buildings and famous people. [1] They are like small lessons in culture, history and nature. Paper money isn't just for spending—it's also for learning.
Let's start with China. [2] On the 20 yuan note (纸币), there is the Lijiang River in Guilin, with green mountains rising from calm waters. [3] On the 5 yuan note, you'll find Mount Tai, one of the most famous mountains in China. A large number of poems were written in praise of it.
[4] Switzerland's notes include mountains, rivers, and even wind patterns (图案)! Canada's have snowy landscapes and maple (枫树) leaves.
These days, many people use phones or cards as a way to pay. [5] But paper money still has its value—not only in money, but in meaning. You can hold it, look at it, and learn from it. It can be a tiny museum in your pocket.
So next time you hold your paper money, take a second look.
wordbank: Other countries do this too, in their own way.
It's so beautiful that artists have painted it for centuries.
The Chinese yuan is a perfect mix of nature and tradition.
These pictures often show what each country finds important.
Today's coins and paper money are nothing like early money.

questions.translation: 你将发现河流、山脉、建筑和名人的图片。这些图片通常展示了每个国家认为重要的东西。
questions.explanation: 故选 These pictures often show what each country finds important.。

questions.translation: 让我们从中国开始。中国元是自然与传统的完美融合。
questions.explanation: 故选 The Chinese yuan is a perfect mix of nature and tradition.。

questions.translation: 桂林漓江……它是如此美丽，以至于几个世纪以来艺术家们一直在描绘它。
questions.explanation: 故选 It's so beautiful that artists have painted it for centuries.。

questions.translation: 其他国家也以自己的方式这样做。瑞士的钞票包括山脉、河流……
questions.explanation: 故选 Other countries do this too, in their own way.。

questions.translation: 如今，许多人使用手机或卡片作为支付方式。它又快又容易。
questions.explanation: 故选 It's fast and easy.。
